## Speed Reading ⚡

No leas toda la frase primero. Mira las opciones.

* Si las palabras son similares (quick, quickly), es **Gramática**.
* Si son diferentes, es **Vocabulario**.
parts.audio: In Part 5, time is money. First, look at the options. Determine if it is a grammar question or a vocabulary question before reading the full sentence.

**Memo: Office Renovation**
_To: All Staff
From: Facilities

Please be advised that the 4th floor will be closed for renovations starting next Monday. All employees seated in this area should relocate to the temporary desks on the 2nd floor. We apologize for the inconvenience._

What are employees asked to do?
questions.explanation: La respuesta se encuentra explícitamente en el texto del memo.
